project: DemandIQ is an AI-based demand forecasting and inventory planning system using machine learning models and analytics dashboards.
forecast graph: The forecast graph compares predicted demand with required stock levels.
order planning: Order planning ensures inventory availability while minimizing overstock.
project objective: The objective of DemandIQ is to help businesses reduce stock shortages and overstocking by predicting future demand using data-driven forecasting techniques.
founder: DemandIQ project was developed and designed by Pradap as a final year Computer Science and Engineering project.
developer: The system was developed by Pradap from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering as part of an academic AI and Data Analytics project.
department: This project belongs to the Computer Science and Engineering department because it involves machine learning, data analytics, web development, and intelligent decision systems.
why this project: DemandIQ was created to solve real-world retail inventory problems where businesses struggle to estimate future demand accurately.
forecast: Forecasting predicts future weekly sales using historical data patterns analyzed by Prophet and XGBoost models.
prophet: Prophet is a time-series forecasting model developed by Meta that automatically detects trends and seasonal patterns in sales data.
xgboost: XGBoost is a machine learning algorithm that learns complex relationships from historical data to improve prediction accuracy.
safety stock: Safety stock is additional inventory maintained to protect against unexpected demand increases or supply delays.
order quantity: Order quantity represents how many units should be replenished based on predicted demand and safety stock calculation.
dashboard: The DemandIQ dashboard provides visualization of historical sales, forecast demand, required stock, and weekly order planning.
technology: DemandIQ is built using Python Flask for backend, JavaScript and Chart.js for frontend visualization, and machine learning models for forecasting.
dataset: The project uses a retail dataset containing 45 stores and 99 departments to simulate real-world demand forecasting scenarios.
ai assistant: The DemandIQ AI Assistant is a lightweight retrieval-based system that answers user questions using project knowledge stored in a structured knowledge base.
rag: The assistant uses a lightweight Retrieval-based approach where user queries are matched against stored project knowledge to generate contextual responses.
benefits: DemandIQ helps organizations improve inventory planning, reduce losses, and make data-driven business decisions.
future scope: Future improvements include real-time data integration, automated purchasing recommendations, and advanced AI analytics.
user role: Users can analyze demand trends, generate forecasts, and view suggested stock orders through an interactive dashboard.
admin role: Admin users manage system access and monitor forecasting operations.
business value: The system converts raw sales data into actionable insights that help businesses optimize supply chain management.
about pradap: Pradap is the developer and designer of DemandIQ, focusing on applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to solve practical business problems.
skills used: This project uses skills including Python programming, machine learning, time-series forecasting, web development, and data visualization.
why ai: Artificial intelligence is used to automate demand prediction and reduce manual estimation errors in inventory management.
decision support: DemandIQ acts as a decision support system by recommending stock orders based on predictive analytics.
real world use: Retail stores and supply chain companies can use systems like DemandIQ to improve operational efficiency and reduce inventory risk.
